items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Career-best performance in win
items.text:
Tuten rushed 16 times for 104 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for 55 yards and another score in the Jaguars' 42-7 win over the Colts on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Logs 12 touches in potential swan song
items.text:
Taylor rushed eight times for 23 yards and brought in four of five targets for 24 yards in the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.title: Bucky Irving: Career-high rushing yards in win
items.text:
Irving rushed 27 times for 170 yards and a touchdown in the Buccaneers' 16-0 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.title: Geno Smith: Late INT seals sixth loss
items.text:
Smith completed 20 of 32 passes for 290 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders. He also rushed once for four yards.
